## Sanity Compliance

- [ ] CHK001 Copyright header present on all new Python files (`# Copyright (c) <year> Opsmill` + GPLv3)
- [ ] CHK002 `__future__` imports and `__metaclass__ = type` boilerplate present in all new files
- [ ] CHK003 `DOCUMENTATION`, `EXAMPLES`, `RETURN` docstrings complete and valid YAML in module stub
- [ ] CHK004 `ansible-test sanity` passes with zero errors (`invoke tests-sanity`)
- [ ] CHK005 Ruff check passes with no violations (`invoke lint`)

## Idempotency and State

- [ ] CHK006 Module reports `changed: true` only when actual mutations are made to Infrahub
- [ ] CHK007 Running module twice with identical params yields `changed: false` (idempotency)
- [ ] CHK008 `state: absent` on non-existent object yields `changed: false` (absent no-op)
- [ ] CHK009 `check_mode` makes zero API calls — only predicts `changed` status
- [ ] CHK010 `--diff` output shows accurate before/after state for create, update, and delete operations

## SDK Integration

- [ ] CHK011 Conditional `HAS_INFRAHUBCLIENT` import using `try/except ImportError` pattern
- [ ] CHK012 Runtime check for SDK availability before any API call (`fail_json` or `AnsibleError` if missing)
- [ ] CHK013 All API calls go through `InfrahubclientWrapper` — no direct `InfrahubClientSync` usage
- [ ] CHK014 `handle_infrahub_exceptions_decorator` applied to SDK-calling methods (or equivalent try/except in action plugins)
- [ ] CHK015 Environment variable fallbacks for `INFRAHUB_ADDRESS` and `INFRAHUB_API_TOKEN`
- [ ] CHK016 `no_log=True` set on token parameter to prevent credential leakage

## Error Handling

- [ ] CHK017 `GraphQLError` mapped to user-friendly Ansible error message
- [ ] CHK018 `SchemaNotFoundError` handled for invalid `kind` parameter
- [ ] CHK019 `ServerNotReachableError` / `ServerNotResponsiveError` handled with clear connectivity error message
- [ ] CHK020 Missing required parameters produce clear, actionable error messages

## Test Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Unit tests exist for all state transitions (create, update, delete, no-change)
- [ ] CHK022 Unit tests mock SDK client via `@patch` — no external dependencies required
- [ ] CHK023 Integration test playbook exists in `tests/integration/targets/<name>/tasks/main.yml`
- [ ] CHK024 All tests pass in Docker pipeline (`invoke tests-all`)

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
